prefs.ai_about: Optional. Only for the words on screen, the names of files you make for it, and the link in the sidebar. Nothing is connected to it.
prefs.ai_url_about: Empty for its usual page. A link of your own can go to your school account, a project or your own saved helper.
prefs.ai_opens: A click on its name opens it
prefs.ai_side: In a window on the right
prefs.ai_others_about: A click on your assistant’s name in the sidebar lists these too. Pick one there and it opens and becomes the one in use, with its own link.
prefs.ai_side_about: Side by side: it is in the sidebar on every screen. In Chrome, right-click it there and choose Open link in split view to have both in one window. Grading Studio sends nothing to it; it sees only what you paste or attach.
prefs.ai_blocked: The browser stopped it from opening. Allow pop-ups for this page, then try again.
prefs.ai_step_list: Change the assistants you switch to
prefs.see_h: What your assistant can and can’t see
prefs.see_1: Nothing reaches an AI assistant unless you give it a file yourself. Papers, names, scores and comments stay in this browser and in your own linked folder.
prefs.see_2: Share with your assistant, in an assignment’s Setup, makes a file for you to give it: the papers with names covered, or your marks only. Each student is a random code, and the key to the codes stays in this browser.
prefs.see_3: The Planner folder holds lessons only. If you let your assistant work in a folder on your computer, make it that one: grading work never goes in it, and the Planner refuses a folder that holds grading files.
prefs.see_4: My setup, under Classes, can give your assistant a prompt to write your setup for you. It never has anything about a student in it.
prefs.prog_about: For example IB MYP. A new class for an MYP teacher starts with MYP criteria. Leave it empty if it doesn’t apply.
prefs.dp_about: How a class average or a term grade is written on the Grades tab and in the gradebook. Nothing is rounded where it is worked out.
prefs.goal_about: Your own list: a skill, a standard, anything you want to see scores by.
prefs.goal_none: Optional. A goal is anything you want to see scores by: a skill like “Uses evidence”, or a standard from your school. Tag rubric rows and quiz questions with a goal, and each class gets a Goals tab.
prefs.goal_add: A new goal, in your words
prefs.goal_tags: Tag rubric rows in Rubric setup and quiz questions in Quiz boxes. A goal you remove comes off whatever was tagged with it; no score changes.
prefs.goal_twice: That goal is already on the list.
prefs.back_about: How the files you hand back start out. The Return box can change these for one assignment.
prefs.back_names: Name each file for the student and the assignment
prefs.sys_about: Only for the words on screen. Nothing is connected to it.
prefs.sys_step: Change where students hand in work
prefs.size_about: Makes the app’s words bigger or smaller on this computer. The paper you are marking keeps its own zoom.
prefs.full_about: Hides the browser’s bars. F does the same from anywhere but a text box, and Esc leaves it.
prefs.su_about: How you work, as one block of text: your classes and when they meet, the calendar, terms, how you grade, saved rubrics and comments. Never anything about a student. Bring one in from your assistant or a colleague, or copy yours for another computer.
prefs.su_step1: Copy the prompt and give it to your AI assistant. It asks you what it doesn’t already know and writes your setup.
prefs.su_step1_named: Copy the prompt and give it to {name}. It asks you what it doesn’t already know and writes your setup.
prefs.su_step2: Paste what it gives back here, then check it. Nothing changes until you have seen what would.
prefs.su_err_empty: Nothing to read yet. Paste the setup text first.
prefs.su_err_long: That is too long to be a setup. A setup is a few pages of text at most.
prefs.su_err_notours: That text isn’t a Grading Studio setup: it has no "gradingStudioSetup" line. Ask your assistant for the setup block again, using the prompt.
prefs.su_err_none: No setup found in that text. A setup starts with { and ends with }. If your assistant cut it short, ask it for the whole block again.

prefs.su_left.one: Something about students was in the text. It was left out: students come in only on a class’s own page.
prefs.su_left.other: {n} things about students were in the text. They were left out: students come in only on a class’s own page.

prefs.su_unknown: Not understood, so left as they are: {list}.
prefs.su_notes: Some of it was written for a newer version or in a way this one doesn’t know, so it is left as it is.
prefs.su_same: Nothing here would change: it is all as you have it.

prefs.su_done.one: Brought in 1 part of the setup.
prefs.su_done.other: Brought in {n} parts of the setup.

prefs.su_failed: That didn’t work, and nothing was changed. Try again.
prefs.su_undone: Put back as it was before the setup came in.
prefs.su_undone_kept: Put back, except what you have used since.
prefs.su_out_about: The same kind of text, from what is here, for another computer or a colleague. It never has a roster, a score or a paper.
prefs.su_s_school: Only the words the app uses. Nothing is connected to these.
prefs.su_order_last: The entry list goes by last name
prefs.su_order_first: The entry list goes by first name
prefs.su_order_roster: The entry list goes by the roster
prefs.su_unit_none: No place named for unit plans
prefs.su_ai_url_none: Your assistant opens at its usual page
prefs.su_ai_tab: Your assistant opens in a new tab
prefs.su_ai_side: Your assistant opens in a window on the right of the screen
prefs.su_ai_urls: Other assistants with a link of your own: {list}
prefs.su_ai_urls_none: No other assistant has a link of your own
prefs.su_ai_off: Not in the sidebar’s list of assistants: {list}
prefs.su_ai_off_none: Every assistant the app knows is in the sidebar’s list
prefs.su_roles: Spots for people on the School page: {list}
prefs.su_s_grading: Assignments you already have keep their own rubric and scale, and no score changes.
prefs.su_total: Scored with a total out of {n}
prefs.su_top_whole: Each row is scored 0 to {n}, whole points only

prefs.su_scale.one: A grading scale from scores to percents (1 step)
prefs.su_scale.other: A grading scale from scores to percents ({n} steps)

prefs.su_s_classes: Classes you already have stay, with their students and their work. No student is added by this.
prefs.su_links: A link to the school’s system for {list}
prefs.su_ib: IB programme, criteria and grade boundaries for {list}
prefs.su_course: Course for {list}. Classes on the same course are linked.
prefs.su_times: Meeting times for {list}, in the timetable
prefs.su_s_calendar: Added to the calendar. Days off already there stay.
prefs.su_s_terms: An assignment counts toward the term its due date falls in.
prefs.su_h_book: What a grade is made of
prefs.su_s_book: For all your classes. Scores are not changed; grades are worked out again from them.
prefs.su_empty_zero: A type with nothing in it yet counts as 0
prefs.su_empty_other: When a type has nothing in it yet, the other types are used
prefs.su_xc_ic: Extra credit adds to in-class work
prefs.su_xc_term: Extra credit adds to the term grade
prefs.su_rt_high: On a retake, the highest score counts
prefs.su_rt_last: On a retake, the latest score counts
prefs.su_rt_avg: On a retake, the average of the tries counts
prefs.su_s_rubrics: Picked on any assignment, in Rubric setup.
prefs.su_rubrics_chg: New wording for {list}, which you already have
prefs.su_s_comments: Added to the comments you pick from while marking.

prefs.su_comments.other: {n} comments to pick while marking, such as “{first}”

prefs.su_s_goals: To tag rubric rows and quiz questions with.
prefs.su_s_deck: For every deck you make from now on.
prefs.su_agenda: An agenda is added on slide 2
prefs.su_noagenda: No agenda is added on slide 2
prefs.su_sizes: Slide text stays between 28 and 36 pt
prefs.su_sizes_any: Slide text can be any size from 18 to 44 pt
prefs.su_s_mark: No paper, mark or score changes.
prefs.su_xnames: Files you hand back are named for the student and the assignment
prefs.su_xnames_off: Files you hand back keep the names they were turned in with
prefs.su_xone: Each student gets one PDF with all their papers
prefs.su_xone_off: Each paper goes back as its own file
prefs.su_cover: Names are covered on anchor papers you export
prefs.su_cover_off: Names are not covered on anchor papers you export
prefs.su_find: Typed names are found and covered for you
prefs.su_sheet: The grade sheet also shows grades found on the papers
prefs.su_sheet_off: The grade sheet shows only the scores given in the app
prefs.su_listpts: The student list shows points out of the total
prefs.su_pts_credit: Points are coloured by credit: full, part or none
prefs.su_pts_pen: Points are written in the pen’s colour
prefs.su_fs_show: In full screen the student list and the tools stay beside the paper
prefs.su_fs_all: In full screen the student list and the tools hide until you point at them
prefs.su_fs_hide: In full screen the student list hides until you point at it
prefs.su_mail_gmail: Email buttons open a new message in Gmail
prefs.su_mail_outlook: Email buttons open a new message in Outlook on the web
prefs.su_mail_app: Email buttons open the computer’s own mail app
prefs.su_fc_pe: Planning outside focus sessions counts after {n} minutes of steady work
prefs.su_fc_pe_off: Planning counts only in focus sessions
prefs.su_fc_sg: A goal is suggested for each session
prefs.su_fc_sg_off: No goal is suggested for sessions
prefs.su_fc_sound: A soft chime when a session or a break ends
prefs.su_fc_sound_off: No chime when a session ends
prefs.su_fc_title: The time left shows in the browser tab’s name
prefs.su_fc_title_off: The time left stays out of the browser tab’s name
prefs.su_fc_track: Grading and planning time are counted
prefs.su_fc_track_off: Grading and planning time are not counted
prefs.su_fc_free: Free periods are offered for grading
prefs.su_fc_free_off: Free periods are not offered for grading
prefs.su_fc_quiet: Counts are hidden during a focus session
prefs.su_fc_quiet_off: Counts stay on during a focus session
prefs.su_fc_short: Shortest papers first in a focus session
prefs.su_fc_short_off: Papers in their usual order in a focus session
prefs.su_fc_music: Lo-fi music while a session runs
prefs.su_fc_music_off: No music while a session runs

prefs.su_fc_idle.one: Time stops counting after 1 minute with nothing done
prefs.su_fc_idle.other: Time stops counting after {n} minutes with nothing done

prefs.su_fc_wk: A look back at the week on {day}
prefs.su_fc_wk_off: No look back at the week
prefs.su_fc_mood: The music’s mood, volume and background sound
prefs.su_td_words: Words that bring a line to {name}: {words}
prefs.su_s_todo_gone: Deleted: {list}. Their lines go to the category their words fit.
prefs.su_att_off: Don’t take attendance in Grading Studio
prefs.su_s_tabs: The other pages stay under More.
prefs.su_tabs_none: Only Assignments, Gradebook and Students in the tab row
prefs.sv_google_about: Sign in with Google and your classes, scores, plans and to-dos stay the same on every computer and phone you sign in on. Only a hidden folder of the app’s own in your Drive is used, and nothing else in your Drive can be seen.
prefs.sv_st_away: waits until the page is in front
prefs.sv_st_offline: offline: syncs when you are back online
prefs.sv_auto: Renew it by itself every hour
prefs.sv_auto_about: Google asks again every hour. Left on, Google’s small window opens for a moment, usually as you come back to the app. Turned off, syncing waits until you press Sign in again.
prefs.sv_none: Google sign-in works at the app’s web address, not in a copy opened from a file.
prefs.sv_offline: Couldn’t reach Google. Check the internet connection.
prefs.sv_sample: Google Drive isn’t used while the sample is open.
prefs.sv_st_full: marks synced; your Google Drive is full, so papers stay here
prefs.sv_st_notsent: marks synced; papers not sent yet
prefs.pf_about: A folder of its own on this computer where {name} can read and change your lessons, units, activities, rubrics and timetable. Drafts saved there arrive on your course lines, marked not reviewed. Grading work never goes in it.
prefs.pf_no_api: This browser can’t link a folder. Chrome or Edge on a computer can.
prefs.pf_ask: This browser needs your permission again for
prefs.pf_sample: This is the sample, so linking a folder is switched off here. Leave the sample to use it with your own lessons.
prefs.pf_grading: That folder has Grading Studio’s grading files in it. Pick or make a folder just for planning, like “Lessons”.
prefs.pf_nothing: No changes in the Planner folder
prefs.pf_came_both: {a} new, {c} updated from the Planner folder
prefs.pf_arrived: Arrived from your Planner folder, not reviewed.
prefs.pf_changed: Changed by {name} in your Planner folder, not reviewed. Yours is under Versions.
prefs.pf_read_through: Read it through, then mark it reviewed.
prefs.pf_back_done: Back to your version. {name}’s is under Versions.
prefs.phone_about: On a phone, bigger buttons and tabs along the bottom. Papers stay on the computer; scores, attendance, plans and to-dos work here.
prefs.phone_on: Use the phone layout on a phone
prefs.phone_next: Takes effect the next time the page opens on a phone
prefs.phone_try_about: To see it here, open a narrow window of this app. It has the same work.
prefs.ph_s1: Point your phone’s camera at the code and tap the link, or type the address above.
prefs.ph_s2: On an iPhone: in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
prefs.ph_s3: On Android: in Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu, then Add to Home screen or Install app.
prefs.ph_s4: Open Grading Studio from your Home Screen and tap Sign in with Google. Use the same Google account as on this computer.
prefs.ph_unverified: If Google says it hasn’t verified the app, tap Advanced, then Go to Grading Studio. The sign-in key was made for your copy rather than reviewed by Google, and the app can only use its own hidden folder in your Drive.
prefs.ph_then: Your classes, scores and to-dos then stay the same on both. You can type scores and look at papers on the phone; marking stays on the computer.
prefs.ps_bring_h: Bring your work from your computer
prefs.ps_bring: Sign in with the same Google account as on your computer. Your classes, scores, plans and to-dos then come here.
prefs.ps_again_h: Google wants you to sign in again
prefs.ps_again: Your work here waits to sync until you do.
prefs.tch_about: For a touch screen. A mouse and a trackpad work as they always have.
prefs.tch_auto: draws, until you use a pencil; from then on it moves the page
prefs.tch_press: A pencil’s line gets wider as you press harder
prefs.tch_two: Two fingers always move the page, and a pinch zooms. While the pencil is on the paper, a hand resting on the screen does nothing.
prefs.wl_h: Mark papers, plan lessons, hand work back.
prefs.wl_lead: Three quick questions and you’re marking. You can change every answer later.
prefs.wl_names_later: Student names are optional and come later: paste a class list on a class’s page, or skip it.
prefs.wl_hand_in: Where do students hand in work?
prefs.wl_paper: On paper, or I’d rather not say
prefs.wl_its_name_l: The name of your school’s system
prefs.wl_sys_why: Only so the app can use its name. Nothing is connected to it, and nothing is sent.
prefs.wl_grade_why: This is only what a new assignment starts with. Any assignment can be scored another way.
prefs.wl_kept_q: Where should your work be kept?
prefs.wl_folder_on: Saving to the folder “{name}” as well as this browser.
prefs.wl_kept_say: Your classes, papers, marks and scores are kept in this browser. Choose a folder on this computer and every save goes there too, with a copy of each day to go back to. Nothing is uploaded.
prefs.wl_later: You can also do this later, in Settings.
prefs.wl_kept_nopick: Your classes, papers, marks and scores are kept in this browser. This browser can’t save to a folder by itself (Chrome or Edge on a computer can), so make a take-home file now and then, in Settings. The sidebar reminds you.
prefs.wl_sample: Look around with a sample class first
prefs.wl_other_pc: Already use Grading Studio on another computer?
prefs.wl_bring_say: Choose your Grading Studio folder, or bring in a take-home file. Your classes and work come with it.
prefs.wl_ai_q: Have an AI assistant that knows how you teach?
prefs.wl_cant: Your answers couldn’t be saved. Try again.
prefs.wl_done_cls: You’re set up. Open a class’s papers here, or click a class in the sidebar to add its students.
prefs.wl_done: You’re set up. Open some papers here, or add a class in the sidebar.
